classification.difficultyReason: Read two marked coordinates from each graph and calculate the signed rise divided by the run.

content.prompt: Find the gradient of each of the following lines.

spec.description: Un gridded Cartesian graph with a rising straight line and marked points at the origin and (2,5); no numbered ticks.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied coordinates are shown; gradient is withheld.

spec.description: Cartesian axes and a descending line with marked intercepts (-5,0) and (0,-3); no grid or numbered ticks.
spec.answerVisibility: Intercept coordinates are supplied; gradient is withheld.

spec.description: Cartesian axes and a rising line through marked points (-2,2) and (5,6); no grid or numbered ticks.
spec.answerVisibility: Point coordinates are supplied; gradient is withheld.

spec.description: Cartesian axes and a descending line through marked points (-2,5) and (5,-2); no grid or numbered ticks.
spec.answerVisibility: Point coordinates are supplied; gradient is withheld.
